title: Nucleic Acids Preparation Protocol
author: Adriana Alberti

steps.title: Cryogenic Grinding
steps.instruction: Process samples using a 6,770 or 6,870 Freezer/Mill (SPEX SamplePrep) according to the specified grinding program.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool for 2 min.
Perform first grinding cycle at 10 knocks per second for 1 min.
Cool for 1 min.
Perform final grinding cycle at 10 knocks per second for 1 min.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Filtration
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cryogrinded powder in 2 ml RA1 lysis buffer containing 1% β-mercaptoethanol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to a large capacity NucleoSpin Filter (RNA Midi kit, Macherey-Nagel #740962).
Centrifuge for 10 min at 1,500 g.
Add an additional 1 ml RA1 lysis buffer with 1% β-mercaptoethanol.
Centrifuge again for 3 min at 1,500 g.

steps.title: DNA Extraction and Elution
steps.instruction: Isolate DNA from the filter eluate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer eluate to a new tube and add one volume of 70% ethanol; mix well.
Load the mixture to a NucleoSpin RNA Mini spin column and wash twice with 700 µl DNA wash solution.
Elute DNA using three successive elutions of 100 μl DNA elution buffer (NucleoSpin RNA/DNA Buffer Set #740944).
Store DNA in sterile microtubes at -20 °C.

steps.title: DNA Quality Control
steps.instruction: Optional: Verify DNA quality by running 1 μl of a sample subset on a 0.7% agarose gel for 60 min at 100 V.

steps.title: In-Column RNA Purification and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Immediately proceed with RNA purification on the previous NucleoSpin RNA Mini spin column by digesting residual genomic DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNase reaction mixture: add 10 μL reconstituted rDNase to 90 μL Reaction Buffer for rDNase (NucleoSpin RNA #740955) in a 1.5 ml tube; mix by flicking.
Apply 95 μL of the mixture directly onto the center of the silica membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Elute RNA in 60 μl RNase-free water and store in sterile microtubes at -80 °C.
Quantify RNA using a Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer with Qubit RNA HS Assay.
Assay RNA quality via capillary electrophoresis on a Bioanalyzer 2100 using the RNA 6,000 Pico LabChip kit.

steps.title: Additional Post-Extraction DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform a secondary DNase treatment to ensure complete removal of genomic DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL DNAse to the sample, mix by gently flicking (do not vortex), and incubate for 30 min at 37 °C.
Elute RNA in 9–15 μl nuclease-free water using two elution steps to maximize recovery.
Purify the reaction mixture using the RNA Clean and Concentrator-5 kit (Zymo Research #R1015) for retention of >17 nt RNA fragments.
Quantify purified RNA with Qubit RNA HS Assay and assess DNase efficiency via PCR on a sample subset.

steps.title: Prokaryote-Targeted Extraction (Alternative)
steps.instruction: Follow this procedure for size fractions targeting prokaryotes.

substeps.instruction: Cut filters into small pieces and wash with pre-chilled PBS buffer, passing the solution through a 0.22 μm glass cup filtration system to avoid cell loss.
Place filter pieces in a 50 ml falcon tube with 1 ml 0.5 mm glass beads, 2 ml 0.1 mm Zirconia beads, and 10 ml buffer RLT + 1% β-mercaptoethanol.
Shake for 15 min in a MoBio Vortex (Vortex-Genie 2).
Centrifuge at 4,500 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Transfer supernatant to a new 50 ml falcon tube and centrifuge for 10 min at 4,500 g.
Transfer ~10 ml supernatant to a new 50 ml tube, add 1 volume 70% ethanol, and mix by inversion four times.
Divide mixture in two and load each separately (700 μl aliquots) into two RNeasy mini columns using a vacuum pump.
Wash each column with 700 μl Buffer RW1 and twice with 500 μl Buffer RPE.
Elute RNA with 70 μl RNase-free water.
Quantify RNA using Nanodrop ND-1000 and Qubit Fluorometer.

steps.title: Girus DNA Extraction (Modified CTAB)
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from giant virus size fractions using a modified CTAB protocol.

substeps.instruction: Crush filters in liquid nitrogen and incubate at 60 °C for 1 hour in CTAB buffer.
Purify DNA using an equal volume of chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (24:1) and perform a 1-hour RNase digestion step.
Precipitate DNA with 2/3 volume of isopropanol and wash with 1 ml of 76% v/v ethanol and 10 mM ammonium acetate solution.
Dissolve DNA in 100 μl laboratory grade deionized water and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Virus DNA Extraction from Seawater
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from 0.2–1.6 μm and 0.2–3 μm filters.

substeps.instruction: Cut membranes into small pieces and dispatch equally into two vials.
Add 1 ml RA1 lysis buffer (NucleoSpin RNA Midi #740962) and 1% β-mercaptoethanol to vials.
Resuspend cryoground powders in 2 ml RA1 lysis buffer with 1% β-mercaptoethanol, pool, and transfer to a single NucleoSpin Filter Midi.
Centrifuge for 20 min at 1,500 g.
Add 1 ml RA1 lysis buffer with 1% β-mercaptoethanol and centrifuge for 3 min at 1,500 g.
Transfer eluate to a new tube, add 1 volume 70% ethanol, load to NucleoSpin RNA Mini column, and wash twice with 700 µl DNA wash solution.
Elute DNA with three 100 μl elutions of DNA elution buffer and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using a standard phenol-chloroform extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add lysozyme (1 mg/ml final) and incubate at 37 °C for 45 min with slight shaking.
Add SDS (1% final) and proteinase K (0.2 mg/ml final) and incubate at 55 °C for 60 min with slight shaking.
Add equal volume Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol (25:24:1), mix, and centrifuge for 10 min at 3,000 g.
Recover aqueous phase and repeat the Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol (25:24:1) extraction (centrifuge 10 min at 3,000 g).
Add equal volume Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol (24:1) to remove residual phenol; centrifuge and recover aqueous phase.
Concentrate aqueous phase and wash three times by adding 2 ml sterile MilliQ water each time.
Quantify isolated DNA using Nanodrop ND-1000 and check integrity on 1.5% agarose gel.
